2719-3899-5756.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

222-527-5295-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5295-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-6495-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6495-6594.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-6495-6594.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

215-2404-2872-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-2872-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Clever Conjurer any number of times.

3263-6620-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-6620-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Sylvan Safekeeper.

2103-4823-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Timeless Witness.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Timeless Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

670-1619-3175-4681-5686.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-3175-4681-5686.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-3175-4681-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-4681-5686.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

2334-2724-3987.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Soulherder. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-2292-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1869-1916-5231.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Titan with haste.
The token Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Titan.
The nontoken Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Titan trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Titan token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-4689-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

930-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3652-4053-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3518-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

673-813-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Planar Incision.
673-813-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4499-4893-6463.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Meticulous Artisan.
When Meticulous Artisan enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1-2498-5436-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2498-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

969-1069-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
969-1069-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

116-950-4639.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-950-4639.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Fatestitcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

2645-3043.notablePrerequisites: Axebane Guardian does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five creatures with defender.
2645-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3043.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

242-2034-4758-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Seraph of the Scales, adding {C}{C}.
When Seraph of the Scales dies, its afterlife ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Seraph of the Scales to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1757-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Edgewall Pack, adding {C}{C}.
When Edgewall Pack dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Edgewall Pack from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Edgewall Pack enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

844-951-1950-2232-2972.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
When Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

643-1486-2719-3337.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of other Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

338-2290.easyPrerequisites: Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2290.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, gaining 2 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
